blocks.content:
Start with a simple question so Assistant can detect a data source, generate a query, and present results. Treat the reply as a draft you can refine.

The first time you open Assistant, a tutorial option may appear. You can reopen it anytime from the chat menu (**Open tutorial**).

whenTrue.content: If this guide is docked in the sidebar, pop it out into a floating window so it stays visible when **Assistant** opens.

blocks.content: To send your first prompt, complete the following steps:
Open **Assistant** from the top toolbar (sparkle icon). You can also select **Assistant** from the left navigation.
blocks.hint: Skip if the Assistant panel is already open. If you do not see the control, confirm Assistant is enabled for your stack.

blocks.content:
In the chat input, paste or type a starter prompt:

> List the data sources available to me

If you have metrics in your stack, you can use:

> Show me CPU usage for the API service
Click **Send** (the arrow next to the chat input).

Review the reply.

Assistant may generate a query, open Explore, or summarize what it found. Use thumbs up or thumbs down when those controls appear. Feedback helps improve answer quality.

You should see a response in the chat.

For product details, refer to [Start your first conversation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/get-started/grafana-cloud/#start-your-first-conversation).

whenTrue.content: Dock this guide back to the sidebar when you are ready for the next milestone.

blocks.content: In the next milestone, you'll use an `@` mention so Assistant targets a specific data source.
